label: Management consulting — MBA summer internship cycle
audience: First-year MBA recruiting for a summer associate/consultant internship (US on-campus calendar; MBB and tier-2 strategy firms)
disclaimer: A curated template of a typical US M7 consulting calendar, not a feed of live firm deadlines. Firms shift dates by a week or two every year and non-US offices run their own cycles. Confirm every date against your career centre and each firm's site, then edit this file — a copy in your data dir at timelines/consulting.json overrides the bundled one.

milestones.name: Pre-term and recruiting kickoff
milestones.description: Firm sites go live, consulting club onboards, resume books close. The list you build now is the campaign you run all year.
actions: Pick 8-12 target firms and add them with add_target_company
Join the consulting club and submit to the resume book
Import your LinkedIn connections so warm paths are ready before events start
Set your base CV so the assistant can tailor against real JDs

milestones.name: Company presentations and office hours
milestones.description: On-campus events are where firms first put a name to your face. Attendance is tracked at most firms.
actions: Attend every target firm's presentation and briefing
Collect names and emails of the consultants you actually spoke to
Log each conversation the same night with log_interaction
Send a short thank-you within 24 hours

milestones.name: Coffee-chat blitz
milestones.description: The heart of consulting recruiting. Referrals and internal advocates decide who gets the first-round invite.
actions: 3-5 chats a week; 2-4 people per target firm across seniority levels
Use find_warm_paths before any cold outreach
Ask about the work, not the process
Set a next_followup date on every single interaction

milestones.name: Case and behavioral prep ramp
milestones.description: Cases take reps, not reading. Start before applications so December is polish, not panic.
actions: Lock in two regular case partners
15-25 live cases before the winter break
Build 6-8 STAR stories that cover leadership, conflict, failure and impact
Drill mental math and chart reading weekly

milestones.name: Applications open through deadlines
milestones.description: Most MBB and tier-2 internship deadlines land in the first half of January. Referrals must be in place before you submit.
actions: Track every application with track_application and set the real deadline
Tailor the CV per firm; write cover letters where they are required
Confirm a referral from your warmest contact at each firm
Submit at least a week early — portals fail on deadline day

milestones.name: First-round interviews
milestones.description: Two or three rounds of behavioral plus case, usually back to back on one day.
actions: 4-6 live cases a week through the round
Re-read your notes on everyone you met at the firm
Thank-you note to each interviewer within 24 hours
Update status to 'interview' so the pipeline stays honest

milestones.name: Final rounds and decision day
milestones.description: Partner-level cases and a real fit assessment. Firms decide the same day at most offices.
actions: Practise partner-style, less-structured cases
Prepare a sharp answer to 'why this firm, why this office'
Have two substantive questions per interviewer

milestones.name: Offers, sell weekends and decisions
milestones.description: Offer deadlines are short and often collide. Ask for extensions early, in writing.
actions: Log every offer deadline as an application deadline
Attend sell weekends for the firms you are genuinely deciding between
Ask for a timing extension the day you need it, not the week it expires

milestones.name: Boutique and off-cycle second wave
milestones.description: Boutiques, regional offices and specialist firms hire well after the on-campus cycle closes, largely through networks.
actions: Add boutiques and regional offices as new targets
Run find_jobs weekly on targets whose boards you already resolved
Reactivate dormant contacts with get_followups
